name: WattNest
tagline: The gentle way to charge, track, and bill every e-bike and scooter in your shop.
positioning: WattNest gives owner-operators one calm dashboard for the charging docks their delivery bikes and rental scooters depend on every single day.

hero.h1: Every battery topped off before the first delivery run
hero.sub: WattNest keeps your charging docks organized, your riders moving, and your energy costs honest — without another spreadsheet or a wall of chargers you have to babysit.

features.title: Dock health at a glance
features.description: See which docks are charging, idle, or faulting across every location, so a dead port never sidelines a rider at 6am.

features.title: Charge-cost accounting
features.description: WattNest ties each charging session to a bike, a rider, and a kilowatt-hour, so you finally know what your fleet actually costs to power.

features.title: Ready-by scheduling
features.description: Tell us when the morning shift rolls out and we sequence charging overnight to hit full batteries by the exact hour you open.

features.title: Rider handoff log
features.description: A tidy record of who took which bike at what charge level — the artifact you reach for when a battery comes back mysteriously empty.

features.title: Off-peak smart draw
features.description: Shift charging into cheaper utility windows automatically and watch the difference land on your monthly power bill.

features.title: Fault alerts that matter
features.description: Get a quiet, specific heads-up the moment a dock stops delivering current — never a firehose of noise you learn to ignore.

testimonials.quote: We run 14 delivery e-bikes out of one storefront. Before WattNest I was walking the charging wall with a clipboard every night. Now the docks tell me what they need and my morning riders never wait.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: The charge-cost report was the surprise. I assumed powering our scooter rentals was a rounding error. It wasn't. WattNest paid for itself the first quarter just by moving us to off-peak charging.
testimonials.name: Deacon Ellery

testimonials.quote: I manage two locations and a shared toolbox of loaner bikes. The rider handoff log ended a very long argument about who kept returning bikes on empty. That alone is worth a seat.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

homepage.footerBlurb: WattNest helps small operators keep every micro-mobility battery charged, tracked, and billed — calmly, and on time.
